title: Minimalist Pink Christmas Patterns
author: Creative Wolf Design
description:
This is a set of 10 Minimalist Pink Christmas Digital Paper patterns, in red, pink and green.
All files are seamless, which means you can easily tile them to create larger prints, without losing quality.
This set includes patterns with checkered patterns with and without Christmas trees, polka dots, stripes and snowflakes.
The fun colour palette is perfect for any Christmas and Holiday Season designs and allows you to easily mix and match the patterns for your creative projects. You can use these for scrapbooking and other paper crafts, home decor, small business marketing and packaging materials, wallpaper, wrapping paper and so much more.
This product comes in 1 Zipped folder (9,77 MB) and includes:
• High Quality SEAMLESS Digital Paper Patterns
• High Resolution, at 300 dpi
• Each file is 12 x 12 inches (305 x 305 mm) or 3600 x 3600 pixels
• 10 PNG files in RGB – Ideal for digital use
• 10 JPEG files in CMYK – Ideal for printing
PLEASE NOTE:
• For better results, use the JPEG files for printing, and the PNG files for digital use
• If you’re sending your files to a print shop, confirm which file type they work with
• Colours may vary due to different screen and printer settings
Thank you for stopping by! Feel free to check out my entire shop, Creative Wolf Design!
